tvShow.name: Rhythm + Flow France
tvShow.overview: French rappers freestyle, battle and write their way to a game-changing 100,000 euro prize in a music competition series judged by Niska, Shay and SCH.

episodes.name: New Season, New Destinations (1)
episodes.overview: As Shay and Niska scout for fresh talent in Brussels, Fort-de-France and Paris, SCH hunts in Marseille and Rouen with the help of special guest Alonzo.

episodes.name: New Season, New Destinations (2)
episodes.overview: Undecided after Paris, Niska goes to Évry. Shay encounters shade in Brussels. Two contenders try to impress SCH on the mic at Miraval Studios.

episodes.name: Crushing the Competition
episodes.overview: With the help of guest judge and veteran rapper Rim'K, the jury must select 15 artists from a pool of 30. Who will make the cut — and who will choke?

episodes.name: Team Spirit
episodes.overview: Nerves flare and egos clash as Dau, Coelho and Warend are given one night to rally their cyphers and create fresh flows. Featuring guest star Médine.

episodes.name: Enemies in the Ring
episodes.overview: Friendships outside the ring turn ruthless as the rappers throw punchlines in one-on-one battles, with coaching help from Ärsenik’s Calbo and Lino.

episodes.name: Action!
episodes.overview: With the quarterfinals upon them, six surviving rappers work with directors from Daymolition to create their own music videos. With special guest Fifou.

episodes.name: The Home Stretch
episodes.overview: The four semifinalists face their hardest challenge yet: rapping live alongside hip hop heavyweights Kalash, Naps, Soso Maness and Kalash Criminel.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.overview: The top three go into the studio with beat makers, write the tracks of their lives and get ready to blow minds on the big stage. Who will win it all?

episodes.name: New Jury, New Rules
episodes.overview: Kickstarting the season directly with the auditions, 20 contenders from France and Belgium come to Paris in the hopes of impressing the brand new jury.

episodes.name: You Are Not Alone
episodes.overview: Before determining the fate of two competitors, SDM, Aya and SCH scout additional talent with help from Guy2Bezbar, Zola, and Sofiane Pamart.

episodes.name: Last Chance
episodes.overview: With six new artists in the mix, the competition starts from scratch. It's a second chance for some as 18 hopefuls craft new lyrics and flows.

episodes.name: Shine or Die
episodes.overview: The 12 remaining competitors enter the cypher round guided by Mac Tyer. While some crumble under the pressure, for others, it's their moment to shine.

episodes.name: Battle Royale (1)
episodes.overview: It's a fight for survival as five pairs of competitors prepare to go head-to-head in a brutal rap battle, with a little help from Aketo and Tunisiano.

episodes.name: Battle Royale (2)
episodes.overview: After revealing the rap battle champions, the jury makes a surprise announcement: the five eliminated rappers get one last chance to stay in the game.

episodes.name: In Da Club
episodes.overview: Six contenders take on a brand new challenge: record a track sampling a famous piece and perform it at a showcase. Will it prove too much for one hopeful?

episodes.name: Back to Basics
episodes.overview: As another rapper exits the game, the final five return to their hometowns with three days to create a killer music video that will blow the jury away.

episodes.name: Dynamic Duo
episodes.overview: Collaborating with Zola, Maureen, Kerchak and Favé, the semifinalists add their own spin to four of the biggest hits in the French rap scene.
